gui.modularmagic.help:
Pick up a node, then left-click a matching slot. Left-click occupied nodes to select; right-click leaves to remove. Parents with children are locked.
Drag canvas space to pan; scroll to zoom. Scroll the parameter panel for more fields.
Reference slots sample the held item's icon, block or first potion effect without consuming it. Right-click a reference slot to clear it. Text boxes still support manual IDs and expressions.
Apply commits edits. Take core extracts the assembly; closing saves it inside the table.
